digest.component_or_area: completion-verification gate, LLM agent runaway guard, evidence caching
propositions: The runaway guard's distinct-ratio arm counts memo-served (free) file reads as loop evidence, punishing the exact repeats the memoization layer was built to absorb, causing RunawayToolLoopError on legitimate completion-verification closes.
The guard sits outermost in the layer composition (Guard→Memo→Steering) so it observes and counts every call before the memo layer can serve it from cache, causing guard-memo conflict.

Finite-evidence boundaries in completion_tool_policy manufacture false met=false verdicts when models exhaust search without reaching required evidence, banking epistemic unknown as substantive unmet failure.

A shared ToolCallLedger with dual-arm guard (ratio arm over EXECUTED calls only, plus served-streak backstop) recomposes guard and memo to count only actual tool execution, not cached repeats, while preserving layer order and completion-policy visibility.
Pure cache-served loops (zero execution for a full guard window) remain bounded by the served-streak arm, and non-allowlisted looping tools still trip the ratio arm on observed executions.
